articles.title: India Clinches Double Gold at Inaugural 2025 Kho Kho World Cup in New Delhi
articles.summary: Both Indian Men's and Women's national squads completed undefeated campaigns at the Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium, defeating Nepal in both finals (Men 54–36, Women 78–40).

articles.title: KL University Contingent Shines at South Zone Inter-University Kho Kho Meet
articles.summary: Student-athletes from KL University (Vaddeswaram & Aziz Nagar campuses) secured podium spots, with 3 players selected for the All India Inter-University Inter-Zonal camp.

articles.title: Ultimate Kho Kho Season 3 Expands Franchises & Broadcast Global Reach
articles.summary: Following Gujarat Giants' thrilling championship win in Season 2, UKK prepares for Season 3 with international draft picks from Nepal, Sri Lanka, and the UK.

articles.title: Olympic Recognition Campaign: Kho Kho Road to Asian Games & Beyond
articles.summary: With 24 nations actively participating at the 2025 World Cup, IKKF and Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) advance technical evaluation for medal sport status in the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games.

articles.title: KKFI Implements Real-time Video Referee & Electronic Pitch Sensing
articles.summary: Standardized electronic mat touch-sensors and ultra-high-speed cameras introduced across senior national circuits to eliminate central-line foul ambiguities.
